author: ohristina
body:
Hi,

My name is Christina, and kingsm in game. I was temporarily banned yesterday for ''trolling my teammates." I truly did not mean to harm my teammates. There were enemies crossing by my team's base as I tried blowing them up. All I was doing was helping out my team by disabling the enemies pathway leading to our base, The moderator saw but thought differently as if I was trying to blow up my team. Thank you for your time.

-kingsm :)

title: Temporarily Banned, Team Troll

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

If you killed your team mates with TNT, it means you were being reckless with TNT, and whether it's intended or not, it's still team grief. It's a short ban, so please wait till it's expired. 

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
